headwords: Talaris (a garment which reached down to the ankles)

english: Talaris (a garment which reached down to the ankles)

contexts.text: Clothed with a talaris () = the proceeding Divine, which is the Divine truth. The reason a talaris (has this signification) is that vestments, in the Word, = truths; hence a talaris, which is a general vestment, when predicated of the Lord, = the proceeding Divine truth. AC 6432:2. AE 64.
The Prince was clad in a talaris of a crimson colour, set with embroidered stars of a silver colour.
The (angelic) husband... was clad in a talaris, and in a vest under the talaris of a hyacinthine colour...
